speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Prison officers and medical personnel comply strictly with national healthcare standards and protocols when managing inmates.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The prison medical service provider also conducts regular health talks for inmates to promote a healthy lifestyle, including education on personal hygiene and not engaging in risky behaviour.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: On the Member's question about whether all inmates can be vaccinated for Hepatitis B, MHA takes reference from the National Adult Immunisation Schedule (NAIS).

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: MHA will continue to regularly review the healthcare approach in our prisons through its Medical Advisory Panel.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I also just take this chance to ask what the Singapore Prison Service is doing to protect our inmates against COVID-19 as well as the prison officers?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: As I am aware that in prisons in other countries, there has been an outbreak of COVID-19 and some of the inmates have actually died from it.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: The Prison Service has taken precautionary measures to protect our staff and inmates.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Prisons is closely monitoring the health and well-being of staff and inmates, and they are regularly reminded on the need to practise good personal hygiene and be socially responsible.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Frontline prison officers are issued Personal Protective Equipment, which includes disposable masks and gloves for use when they interact with all new admissions and any suspected case of COVID-19 in the inmate population.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Prisons has also implemented compulsory temperature screening for all staff and visitors at all access points into prisons facilities.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Essential services such as the bakery, kitchen and laundry will continue.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Visits scheduled on 6 April 2020 will be allowed to continue.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Inmates can also continue to send letters, including e-letters to their families.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I propose to take a short break now, before the Ministerial Statement.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: I suspend the Sitting and will take the Chair at 2.00 pm.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Sitting accordingly suspended  at 1.53 pm until 2.00 pm.
